scheme: Stage 1 general family hypotheses; stage 2 architecture-gated refinement with hard/background-negative exclusion and complete input-protein accounting
benchmark_scope: Validated F1 weights orthology only; raw and weighted scores retained

grades.A: complete family architecture gate and positive orthology support
grades.B: complete family architecture gate without sufficient orthology; panel restriction only when absence was tested
grades.C: partial family architecture and positive orthology support
grades.D: failed architecture gate or partial architecture without orthology support

numerical_identity_probability: Empirical isotonic assignment correctness calibration using positive adhesome controls only; leave-one-exact-sequence-out for overlapping queries. Reference-overlap context and uncertainty retained; not independent validation for novel lineages or an exact gene/paralogue probability.
negative_control_policy: Hard/background negatives are exclusion gates only, never identity training classes. Exact negative sequences or a complete related architecture with an observed negative-specific curated CDD model are excluded from final assignments and retained in negative_control_exclusions.tsv. Shared domains alone cannot exclude a protein.
final_assignment_columns: Compact populated view with putative_audited_family, protein_name and assignment_confidence; raw evidence retained separately
identity_probability_reference_panel_pol: Do not transfer probabilities silently to a changed orthology panel; recalibrate after panel expansion.
